title: Neighbor Spoofing in US Scam Call Complaints
description: Summary of 486,639 US consumer scam and unwanted call complaints across 261,367 caller numbers, measuring how often the caller shared the consumer's own area code. 37.5% overall, 45.6% excluding toll-free callers. Full analysis and free number lookup: https://thescamexposed.com/robocall-checker. Limitations: complaints are consumer reported and unverified, caller ID can be spoofed, topic assignment is approximate.
